analysis.title: Flex (FLEX): Strong results and outlook, with particular strength from the datacenter market; 2QFY27 wrap
key_insights: GS rates Flex Buy with a 12-month price target of $159 (raised from $145), against a $93.03 price, implying 70.9% upside. The target applies 19X (unchanged) to Q5-Q8E EPS including SBC.
2QFY27 (3QCY26) revenue was $8,491 mn (up 25% yoy), above the guidance range of $7,950 mn to $8,250 mn, GS at $8,139 mn and the Street (FactSet) at $8,172 mn.

2QFY27 adjusted EBIT ex-SBC was $607 mn (~7.1% of revenue) vs GS $559 mn (6.9%), Street $557 mn (6.8%) and a guidance range of $535 mn to $565 mn. The Cloud & Power (CPI) segment was especially strong.
2QFY27 non-GAAP EPS ex-SBC was $1.18, above the guidance range of $1.00 to $1.07 and GS and Street at $1.06. Adjusted FCF was $261 mn.

FY27 revenue guidance was raised to $34.9 bn-$35.9 bn (up 25% to 29% yoy) from $33.7 bn-$35.2 bn. Management attributed roughly half of the $950 mn midpoint increase to the underlying business and half to EPC Power.
FY27 adjusted operating margin guidance was raised to 7.6%-7.8% from 7.0%-7.2%, and adjusted EPS guidance to $4.84-$5.16 from $4.42-$4.74. Street was at 7.2% margin and $4.69 EPS.

CPI FY27 revenue growth outlook was raised to 75-85% yoy from 65-75%, in part from the EPC Power deal. CPI adjusted operating margin is guided to 11.5-11.7%, implying ~240 bps of yoy expansion at the midpoint vs ~100 bps prior (the prior guide excluded EPC).

Flex closed the EPC Power acquisition on 10/14 and now includes it in guidance. EPC is expected to add ~$475 mn of revenue to FY27 and be accretive to FY27 EPS. GS had assumed about $450 mn of EPC revenue and slight FY27 dilution.

3QFY27 guidance: revenue $8,870 mn-$9,170 mn ($9,020 mn midpoint) vs GS prior $9,076 mn and Street $8,953 mn. EBIT of $685 mn-$715 mn implies a 7.8% margin vs GS 7.5% and Street 7.3%. EPS of $1.19-$1.25 vs GS $1.20 and Street $1.22.
Implied 4QFY27 guidance at the midpoint is revenue $10.0 bn, EBIT $885 mn and EPS $1.60, vs Street $9.7 bn, $741 mn and $1.41, and GS prior $9.8 bn, $778 mn and $1.40.

The stock had fallen 18% month to date before the print. Management continues to expect strength in its power business in both FY27 and FY28. GS says the focus going forward is the durability of growth and margin potential, per its investor/innovation day preview.

GS raised FY27/28/29 EPS (including SBC) to $4.55/$7.45/$8.75 from $4.16/$7.00/$8.20, driven by higher revenue and operating margin, partly offset by higher interest expense. Ex-SBC estimates are $5.05/$7.95/$9.25.
The FY27 guidance excludes the planned spin-off of the Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment (to be called Axiom), expected in 1QCY27 (4QFY27).
On 800V, management remains committed in CPI and continues to develop SST technology, now complemented by EPC Power. Growth in existing segments is running above peers.
For RemainCo, management expects strength in energy infrastructure (AI and datacenter), robotics and communications (advanced networking), slightly offset by incremental weakness in lifestyle.

market_movers.rationale: Target raised to $159 from $145 on higher FY27-29 EPS estimates after a beat-and-raise quarter led by datacenter and the EPC Power deal. Buy rating maintained.

sector_views.rationale: GS expects Flex to benefit from rising hyperscale capex and market outgrowth, with a portfolio covering power and assembly and EPC adding power management and 800V.
Advanced networking in communications and energy infrastructure and robotics in industrials continue to have growth drivers ahead.

earnings_insights: Flex 2QFY27 (reported 10/28 for 3QCY26): revenue $8,491 mn (reported) vs GS $8,139 mn, Street (FactSet) $8,172 mn and guidance midpoint $8,100 mn.
Flex 2QFY27 non-GAAP EPS ex-SBC $1.18 (reported) vs GS and Street $1.06 estimates. Non-GAAP EPS including SBC was $1.07 (reported) vs GS $0.95.

Flex 2QFY27 non-GAAP operating income ex-SBC $607 mn (reported), 7.1% margin, vs GS estimate $559 mn (6.9%) and Street $557 mn (6.8%). Including SBC, operating income was $564 mn (6.6%) vs GS $518 mn (6.4%).
2QFY27 segment EBIT (reported): RMS $172 mn (6.4% margin) vs GS $171 mn (6.5%), ITS $181 mn (5.5%) vs GS $156 mn (5.2%), CPI $268 mn (10.7%) vs GS $249 mn (10.0%).
3QFY27 guidance (company guide): revenue $8,870 mn-$9,170 mn, non-GAAP EPS ex-SBC $1.19-$1.25 ($1.22 midpoint) vs GS $1.20 and Street $1.22 estimates. CPI is guided up 105%-115% yoy.

FY27 guidance (company guide) midpoint: revenue $35.4 bn, non-GAAP operating income ex-SBC $2,726 mn (7.7% margin), EPS ex-SBC $5.00, vs Street (FactSet) estimates of $34.7 bn, $2,482 mn (7.2%) and $4.69, and GS prior $34.9 bn, $2,548 mn and $4.65.
FY27 segment guide midpoint: RMS up 7% yoy, ITS up 10% yoy, CPI up 78% yoy.
Street estimates likely did not reflect the higher interest expense from the EPC deal, nor the EPC financial impacts in full.
risk_factors: Durability of growth, including company-specific factors
vol_and_positioning: FLEX fell 17.9% over 3 months, rose 6.7% over 6 months and 44.8% over 12 months. Relative to the S&P 500 it is down 21.0% over 3 months, down 1.3% over 6 months and up 29.2% over 12 months.
The stock was down 18% month to date before the print.
